name: suede-aso
description: Suede-owned app-store optimization discipline for keyword fields, titles, subtitles, descriptions, screenshots, ratings context, and competitor listing audits. Use when improving App Store or Google Play visibility or listing conversion from a live app URL and current console evidence. NOT FOR: building or releasing the app (use android-app-factory or site-to-ios-app; native iOS builds are a private Suede Labs companion, not in this pack: ios-app-factory), writing store metadata fields for an ap
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 一套应用商店优化方法，用于审查关键词、文案、截图、评分和竞品，提升商店曝光与下载转化。
